info.name: Good Showroom — Supabase Auth and MongoDB CRM
info.description: Sample test emails and passwords are prefilled; these accounts do not exist until created. Import the companion environment and supply your Supabase public key and setup key, or use the generated PRIVATE environment. Start the backend on port 4000. For a new installation create the initial account in folder 00, then run folders 01–07 in order, including 02B staff creation. Existing installations must use their actual administrator credentials and skip folder 00. Default userCreationMode=direct creates staff identities and memberships; invitation mode supports existing accounts. Tokens and record IDs are saved automatically. CRM folders create sample data. Optional suspension, email, and refresh requests skip unless enabled. Sample passwords are for disposable testing only. No server secrets or MongoDB connection strings are included in this collection.
